{{Otheruses|Board of Directors}}
The '''Smitroo Board of Directors''' was the body of beings in charge of [[Smitroo Industries]]. After their corporation went bankrupt, the Board of Directors seemingly vanished. The [[Explorer Mk. V]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were dedicated to finding them so they could report their findings.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref>
